parsed.why: Self-ID, marriage equality and GI-inclusive equal-treatment law; arrests after the 2024 mob attack and appellate convictions show working recourse. Custody defaults to birth sex but transfer route exists; residual risk is social friction, dated police mistreatment.

Morality provisions de facto criminalise gender nonconformity and transition itself (up to 5 years), religious rulings bar affirming care, no recognition or protections, no registered NGOs; militia killings and torture of gender-nonconforming people under weak rule of law.

Decriminalisation plus a criminalised-discrimination statute are real positives, but implementation gaps are documented, a 2024 police attack and arbitrary detention of a trans woman is only under investigation, gender identity is not an enumerated ground, conservative society.

Never criminalised, with local anti-discrimination ordinances, a right-to-care card and official condemnation of killings; but worst feature is tier-1 custody — trans women in male dorms, mandatory head-shaving, safety via inmate hierarchies — plus service refusals with no national remedy.

Decriminalised in 2021 and historically low reported persecution, but no anti-discrimination law or recognition; police dismiss complaints citing male ID markers, producing documented impunity, with trans assault risk reported at over four times the general population.
